description: This Java class 'Visibility1' is an Android activity demonstrating the use of view visibility states: VISIBLE, INVISIBLE, and GONE. It sets up UI components, assigns click listeners to buttons, and modifies the visibility of a target view based on user interactions.

classes.name: Visibility1
classes.description: Android activity demonstrating view visibility controls with corresponding buttons and event handlers.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets layout, finds views, and attaches click listeners.

methods.name: mVisibleListener
methods.description: Click listener that sets the target view's visibility to VISIBLE.

methods.name: mInvisibleListener
methods.description: Click listener that sets the target view's visibility to INVISIBLE.

methods.name: mGoneListener
methods.description: Click listener that sets the target view's visibility to GONE.
